settings.about_desc: We help organisations build safer, more respectful workplace cultures through research-informed training and practical tools. Our work is grounded in academic research and shaped by frontline experience.

settings.mission_heading: Prevent harm. Promote respect. Build better workplaces.
settings.mission_desc: Our mission is to equip organisations and individuals with the knowledge, tools and confidence to prevent harm before it happens — and to respond to concerns with clarity and care.
settings.approach_intro: We combine academic rigour with real-world experience to deliver education that is:
settings.check_desc_1: Grounded in the latest evidence and data.
settings.check_desc_2: Tailored to the unique needs of your organisation.
settings.check_desc_3: Focused on real scenarios and actionable skills.
settings.check_desc_4: Designed to create respectful, safe environments for all.

settings.holly_roles: CONSENT RESEARCHER · WORKPLACE CULTURE SPECIALIST · DIGITAL HARM EDUCATOR
settings.holly_desc: With years of interdisciplinary research and frontline experience, Holly equips leaders and teams with the knowledge, skills and confidence to prevent harm, respond to concerns and create cultures of respect and trust.
settings.holly_tags: MSc Researcher, Workplace Culture Specialist, Digital Harm Educator, Safeguarding Expert

settings.story_desc_1: Our work began with a simple belief: prevention starts with education. We set out to make evidence-based knowledge accessible and practical for every organisation.
settings.story_desc_2: Through academic research and collaboration, we deepened our understanding of what creates safer workplace cultures — and what drives meaningful change.
settings.story_desc_3: Working alongside organisations across industries, we developed training and resources that help leaders and teams prevent harm and build trusted environments.
settings.story_desc_4: We continue to evolve, learn and innovate — ensuring our education remains relevant, evidence-based and impactful for the future.
